text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said Wednesday it has set a record date of November 12 for participation in the company's previously announced spinoff of its TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc.

TCI Group common stock holders will receive one share of Series A common stock of TCI Satellite Entertainment for each 10 shares of Series A TCI Group common stock held on the record date, and one share of Series B of TCI Satellite common stock for each 10 shares of Series B TCI Group common stock.

The Series A and Series B common stock of TCI Satellite Entertainment is expected to be approved for listing on the Nasdaq National Market under the symbols TSATA.O and TSATB.O, respectively, the company said.
The spinoff of TCI Satellite into a separate public entity, is expected to be consummated in the next several weeks, the company said. A distribution date has not yet been determined.
